title: ArcBio Continuous DNA Workflow - Post-PCR Instrument
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Mix cleanup enzyme with samples
steps.instruction: Combine the post-indexing cleanup enzyme mixture with the DNA samples (up to 96) that are held at 4 °C on the Temperature Module.

steps.title: Transfer to off‑deck thermocycler
steps.instruction: Move the plate to an off‑deck thermocycler and continue with the thermocycling program as described in the attached experimental protocol.
